operations.name: searchSeries
operations.description: Fuzzy-search the BRK catalog by a short concept term before requesting an unfamiliar series.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Short series name or concept to search for.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

operations.name: getSeriesIndexes
operations.description: Return every supported aggregation index and the aliases accepted in series requests.

operations.name: getSeriesInfo
operations.description: Confirm that a canonical series exists, then inspect its supported indexes and value type before fetching data.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Canonical BRK series name. Search first if the exact name is unknown.

operations.name: getSeriesData
operations.description: Fetch one series as JSON with version, index, inclusive start, exclusive end, response timestamp, and data values.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Canonical BRK series name. Search first if the exact name is unknown.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Aggregation index or accepted alias, such as day, day1, week, month, year1, or height.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive start as an integer index, negative offset from the end, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Exclusive end as an integer index, negative offset from the end, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum values to return. BRK ignores this parameter when end is set.

operations.name: getSeriesDataRaw
operations.description: Fetch only the value array for one series. Use the wrapped endpoint when range metadata is needed for alignment.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Canonical BRK series name. Search first if the exact name is unknown.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Aggregation index or accepted alias, such as day, day1, week, month, year1, or height.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive start as an integer index, negative offset from the end, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Exclusive end as an integer index, negative offset from the end, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum values to return. BRK ignores this parameter when end is set.

operations.name: getSeriesLatest
operations.description: Return the single most recent unwrapped value for one series and index.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Canonical BRK series name. Search first if the exact name is unknown.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Aggregation index or accepted alias, such as day, day1, week, month, year1, or height.

operations.name: getSeriesBulk
operations.description: Fetch several canonical series for one index and range. Include date or timestamp when the values will be joined as a time series.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Comma-separated canonical series names, such as date,price_close,market_cap.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Aggregation index or accepted alias, such as day, day1, week, month, year1, or height.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive start as an integer index, negative offset from the end, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Exclusive end as an integer index, negative offset from the end, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum values to return. BRK ignores this parameter when end is set.

operations.name: mempoolGetTipHeight
operations.description: Returns the current mainnet chain-tip height as plain text. Recheck it when an exact current height matters.

operations.name: mempoolGetTipHash
operations.description: Get the current Bitcoin chain-tip hash

operations.name: mempoolGetRecentBlocks
operations.description: Returns a bounded recent-block summary from the current mainnet view.

operations.name: mempoolGetBlockHashByHeight
operations.description: Resolve a block height to its block hash

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Bitcoin mainnet block height.

operations.name: mempoolGetBlock
operations.description: Get a Bitcoin block summary by hash

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: A 64-character Bitcoin block hash.

operations.name: mempoolGetTransaction
operations.description: Returns public mainnet transaction details. Use only when transaction-level detail is needed; very large transactions may exceed platform response limits.

parameters.name: txid
parameters.description: A 64-character Bitcoin transaction ID.

operations.name: mempoolGetTransactionStatus
operations.description: Get confirmation status for a Bitcoin transaction

parameters.name: txid
parameters.description: A 64-character Bitcoin transaction ID.

operations.name: mempoolGetAddressSummary
operations.description: Returns funded, spent, and transaction-count statistics for a user-requested mainnet address. Querying sends that public address to mempool.space. Treat addresses as privacy-sensitive pseudonymous identifiers and never infer identity or ownership from the result.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A public Bitcoin mainnet address supplied or explicitly requested by the user.

operations.name: mempoolValidateAddress
operations.description: Validates a user-requested Bitcoin address and returns its public script metadata. The queried address is sent to mempool.space.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: A public Bitcoin address string supplied or explicitly requested by the user.

operations.name: mempoolGetCurrentMempool
operations.description: Returns a point-in-time public mempool view. It is operational state, not a complete historical series.

operations.name: mempoolGetRecommendedFees
operations.description: Returns fee-rate estimates in satoshis per virtual byte. Estimates are not confirmation guarantees.

operations.name: mempoolGetDifficultyAdjustment
operations.description: Returns a changing estimate for the current adjustment period. Label it as an estimate and include the retrieval time.

operations.name: mempoolGetMiningHashrate
operations.description: Get estimated Bitcoin mining hashrate history

parameters.name: timePeriod
parameters.description: History window supported by mempool.space.

operations.name: mempoolGetMiningBlockFees
operations.description: Get historical block-fee statistics

parameters.name: timePeriod
parameters.description: Block-fee history window supported by mempool.space.

operations.name: polymarketGetTagBySlug
operations.description: Resolve a concise topical slug before market discovery. A successful tag lookup does not by itself establish relevance or market quality.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Concise candidate topic slug to validate, such as bitcoin. If it does not resolve, do not invent a tag ID.

operations.name: polymarketListRelevantMarkets
operations.description: Find candidate markets using an exact tag ID resolved by the tag operation. Keep only Bitcoin, crypto, economic, political, regulatory, liquidity, or macro markets with a material and explainable Bitcoin connection. Liquidity and volume filters are optional aids, not universal quality thresholds.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: A one-item array containing the exact numeric tag ID returned by polymarketGetTagBySlug.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Small response-size cap. Start with the narrowest useful result set.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: Whether to request closed markets. Keep false for current expectations unless the user explicitly asks for history.

parameters.name: liquidity_num_min
parameters.description: Optional adaptive minimum for the API's reported liquidity value. Do not apply a fixed universal cutoff; choose only after considering the scale and peers of the relevant market set.

parameters.name: volume_num_min
parameters.description: Optional adaptive minimum for the API's reported cumulative volume value. Do not apply a fixed universal cutoff; compare relevant candidates first.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Optional live API field used for candidate ordering.

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Sort direction for the selected order field. Use false when seeking the most liquid or highest-volume candidates.

parameters.name: related_tags
parameters.description: Optionally include markets under related tags. Keep false unless broader discovery is necessary and manually recheck relevance.

parameters.name: include_tag
parameters.description: Include tag metadata with each candidate for relevance review.

parameters.name: after_cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior keyset response. Do not invent or alter it.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketById
operations.description: Inspect one public market's question, outcomes, prices, status, activity, spread, and resolution source.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact public Polymarket market ID returned by the API.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketBySlug
operations.description: Get a prediction market by exact slug

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Exact public market slug returned by Polymarket.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketTags
operations.description: Use tags as supporting relevance metadata, not as proof that a market is useful or Bitcoin-related.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact public Polymarket market ID returned by the API.

operations.name: getRepoContent
operations.description: Returns a directory listing or a small file with base64 content. Keep responses below the ChatGPT Action payload limit; use '.' for the repository root.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: GitHub account or organization that owns the public repository.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Public repository name without the owner prefix.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: URL-encoded file or directory path. Use '.' to list the repository root.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.
